And then, recover the passkey from the plate inside the dish-pit. If you can get your hands on the passkey, unlock the gateway with the passkey. If you can get through with that, make an attempt to venture west. Once you accomplish that, take a trip north. And then, make an effort to go east. Then, lift the sandwich from the floor of the parlor. And if you do that, you're the winner!
